record.title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts

public_surface_policy.raw_update_packets: Kept as artifact ZIPs for provenance, source witnesses, TeX, render checks, and repair history.
public_surface_policy.legacy_filename_warning: Older filenames containing Complete or Source-Checked are legacy package names and are not global certification claims.
public_surface_policy.corrections: Corrections and source comparisons can be proposed through GitHub issues or pull requests.

sga5.french: Carried through repair016. A post-repair SGA5 rescan reported no new concrete defects in tested lanes, but this is not an every-symbol global certification.
sga5.english: Unsynchronized carry-forward; do not treat as synchronized with the repaired French branch.

sga6.french: Substantial working draft with repair003 restoring Expose VI source pp.372-387 from source scans.
sga6.repair003_closed_lane: Projective-bundle calculation opening through Remarque 1.14; missing proof material, formulas, statement numbering, and remarks restored for pp.372-387.

sga7_i.status: Working draft material only; current public page keeps explicit compression and source-checking caveats.

workflow_lessons: Use high-quality source scans and page slices as direct witnesses for web/pro repair sessions.
Use OCR and rendered crops as locator/check layers, not as source authority.
Keep French/source branches and English translation branches explicitly separated when synchronization is incomplete.
Public pages should describe remaining dense-region and diagram work instead of relying on optimistic legacy filenames.
